notes.title: Update #1 - Wall Clipping Issues and Bugs Fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Some users were experiencing wall clipping issues and that is why I released a new updated version where most of the issues have been fixed. I also have fixed some minor bugs and the player should not face any interruption during the gameplay. I hope this update will be helpful for the existing as well as future players.

Issues Fixed:
1. Minor bugs have been fixed.
2. Wall clipping issue has been fixed.
3. Modified some scripts for better player's experience.

Thanks to everyone who have supported me! Without your support it was not possible for me to continue making games for you. If you face any further issue please feel free to post about it in the discussions section and I will look into it. Thanks!

I hope you will enjoy this game.

Best Regards,
Anamik
